name: Dinh Bo Linh
role: Warlord who ended the Anarchy of the 12 Warlords and founding emperor (Đinh Tiên Hoàng)
known_facts: Rose from Hoa Lư and defeated the twelve rival warlords (Loạn 12 sứ quân)
Unified the country and founded Đại Cồ Việt in 968
Took the title Đinh Tiên Hoàng and established the capital at Hoa Lư
Assassinated in 979 along with his heir Đinh Liễn
interpretation: 10th-century Đại Cồ Việt / Hoa Lư military dress, based on the user reference.
unknowns: No verified contemporary life portrait survives
